About [Giving birth under A5 in hospital - married, with Bituach Leumi, foreign partner non-citizen]
Hi all, asking for recent experience in administrative work for preparing to give birth in the hospital. I read the article in AIC website about "Giving Birth as an A5 Visa Holder". This week we had a chance to talk to the miyon in Sheba, the ladies told us recently the process has been simplified, there's nothing to do before giving birth, just to make sure 1) in Bituach Leumi it shows that we are married, and to print my bank account details for them to give Maternity Grant (Maanak Leida / מענק לידה). I want to verify if your/your partner who had a recent birth would have such an experience to share? Thank you!
